params.body:
Two reports stood as "File not found on disk" with their PDFs in `store/reports`:

- "The New Luxury is Participation", notes `Uploaded: 1791905134119-Participation_Luxuary_.pdf (1 section, 608 chars)`
- "AA", notes `File: AA_ACIG.pdf`

Every way in records the filename in the notes, but nothing read all of them. The retry button (`/retry-report`) read `File:` and `Google Drive:` only, then fell back to a 20-character substring of the name. The worker's sweep read no notes, only the name, and "The New Luxury" does not match "Participation_Luxuary", while "AA" is too short to match safely (by design).

## What changes
- `noteFile(notes)` in `packages/core/report-files.mjs` reads `File:`, `Google Drive:` and `Uploaded:` (without the section count).
- `resolveReportFile(name, files, notes)` tries that file first, as stored or by its upload safe name, then the existing name rule.
- The worker passes the notes; `/retry-report` uses `resolveReportFile` instead of its own matching, which also drops the unguarded substring fallback the worker lost earlier.

## After deploy
Retry on both reports on the Reports page. KARMA 2026 and ACTIVATE are a different case: the files on disk are a watermark page and a 5-byte placeholder, and need the real PDF uploaded.

## Tests
`test/report-files.test.mjs`: 10 pass, with the two real notes. Full suite 1568 of 1574; the 6 are report-render, which needs pdftoppm.
params.title: Find a report's file by the name its notes give
